meta.challenge: Be An Earth System Trend Detective!
meta.variable: annual mean daily peak heat index (Rothfusz, POWER T2M_MAX + RH derived from T2MDEW)

sources.name: NASA POWER
sources.note: Daily means, 0.5 degree grid. Heat index is derived (Rothfusz on T2M_MAX + dew-point-derived RH), not a POWER product.

narration.note: Numbers come from the trend output; text does not compute or invent values.

meta.disclaimer: Municipality is the smallest unit: POWER's ~55 km grid cannot resolve barangays. Drivers are associations, not causation.

narration.en: Aroroy is getting hotter by about 0.048 °C per year (p < 0.001). The trend is statistically significant, so it is unlikely to be chance. In 2025 the average heat index was 34.9 °C, inside PAGASA's Extreme Caution band. Aroroy has never exceeded the 42 °C Danger threshold.
narration.fil: Ang Aroroy ay umiinit nang humigit-kumulang 0.048 °C bawat taon (p < 0.001). Makabuluhan ang kalakarang ito, kaya malabong nagkataon lamang. Noong 2025, ang karaniwang heat index ay 34.9 °C, nasa antas ng Labis na Pag-iingat ng PAGASA. Hindi pa kailanman lumampas ang Aroroy sa 42 °C na antas ng Panganib.
